meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把混乱的代码拆解重组，理清结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头代码越改越乱，想在不改行为的前提下梳理结构
copy.tagline_en: Break messy code apart and rebuild it into clear structure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has grown messy and you want to reorganize it without changing behavior

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把一次重构拆成六个阶段执行:先确认你的重构意图,再分析代码库、画出依赖与影响范围、评估测试覆盖,然后生成逐步计划并一步步改代码,每改一步就跑测试和类型检查验证。
howto.when: 当你要求重构、简化、抽取或现代化代码时触发;也可以直接输入 /refactor 加目标,并用 --scope 与 --strategy 等参数指定范围。
howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs a refactor in six phases: it confirms your intent, analyzes the codebase, maps dependencies and impact zones, assesses test coverage, generates a step-by-step plan, then executes each step and runs tests and type checks after every change.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code. You can also run /refactor with a target and specify scope and strategy via flags.

say_en.text: /refactor src/auth/handler.ts extract validation into its own module
say_en.note: It first confirms intent, then analyzes the codebase
Module-scoped conservative refactor, tests after each step

say_en.text: /refactor all functions using the deprecated API --strategy=aggressive
say_en.note: With low coverage it may ask to add tests first
